The execution failed because the generated HWPX section XML did not contain the expected formatted birthdate and age string.
The test suite failed in test_outputs.py with an AssertionError. Specifically, test_required_values_present_and_repeated_value_updated failed because '1990-11-02 (35세)' was not found in the generated section0.xml file. Two other tests passed, indicating partial success in generating the document structure, but the specific age-formatting logic or placement needs correction.
